title: phyllanthus myrtilloides subsp. shaferi
intro: Phyllanthus myrtilloides subsp. shaferi, commonly known as the Puerto Rico leaf flower, is a plant species within the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and show anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus myrtilloides subsp. shaferi include its use as an antiviral agent and its potential to lower blood sugar levels. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
